Explain briefly why condensation appears on the outside of a glass of iced water on a humid day. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: Warm, humid air touching the cold glass cools below its dew point, so it can't hold all its water vapor. The excess vapor condenses into liquid droplets on the glass's outer surface.
